body_markdown:
**New York, N.Y., Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NANO Nuclear Energy Inc. (NASDAQ: NNE) (“NANO Nuclear” or “the Company”)** , a leading advanced nuclear micro modular reactor and technology company focused on developing clean energy solutions, nuclear fuel cycle capabilities and nuclear transportation solutions, today announced its participation in recent and upcoming investor conferences.


- **Inaugural ROTH Emerging Nuclear Technology Conference** on October 1st in New York, NY.
- **TD Cowen’s 11th Annual Nuclear Roundtable** on October 8th, held virtually.


- Management will participate in a fireside chat at 2:50 p.m. ET, with the webcast link and a replay available for approximately 30 days on NANO Nuclear’s investor relations website at[https://ir.nanonuclearenergy.com/news-events/events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=VI0AmFbWwpGam9s6-yJqVTrSFfIIy01IRE_pl5fCIEVB_urXq593ZQaThqpTf3oAhAoFbFI4xScc479X5uiuCnTwJ5Jo_O60b8ezsmKbMmYveM-t5qITg0zl2CBmesqmuJGJZepVT7W2iiavbQqGsiSvR-ToM1_A7TF0O_WRins=) .


- **3** **rd** **Annual Daiwa Miami Conference** on November 19th, in Miami, FL.


To request an invitation or to schedule a one-on-one meeting with management at one of the conferences above, please contact your respective investment bank representatives.
